name: Zacharias
bio: Zacharias, a priest of the division of Abijah, and his wife Elisabeth, a descendant of Aaron, were righteous before God but childless and advanced in years. While Zacharias was burning incense in the temple, the angel Gabriel appeared to him, announcing that Elisabeth would bear a son to be named John, who would go before the Lord in the spirit of Elijah. When Zacharias doubted because of their age, Gabriel struck him speechless until the promise was fulfilled. Elisabeth conceived, and when the time came to name the child, Zacharias, still unable to speak, wrote "His name is John"; his speech was immediately restored, and he prophesied over the child, blessing God for raising up a Savior from David's house and foretelling that his son would prepare the Lord's way (Luke 1:5-25, 57-80).
